messages:
dara (Partnerships): Starting a short thread for CipherGrid marketplace onboarding + security integration. We need a concise preflight: SSO (SAML w/ encrypted assertions), SCIM incremental + bulk, BYO-KMS (PKCS#11/HSM) handshake, secrets connector smoke, and embargo dates for joint announcement.

kevin (PM): High-level plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata & certs 2) exercise SCIM incremental sync + bulk import 3) validate KMS wrap/unwrap + attestation 4) run secrets end-to-end 5) lock embargo window.

samir (CipherGrid): We can provide an expiring SAML metadata URL, support encrypted assertions, SCIM v2 endpoint with incremental sync, and a PKCS#11 HSM gateway. We'll attach attestation (FIPS 140-2 L3) and firmware hashes.

viv (Eng): Please put metadata in a signed, expiring location and include expected SAML attributes (email, groups, roles). For SCIM, we need delta sync docs and rate-limit behavior. Also want p50/p95/p99 for KMS wrap/unwrap.

samir (CipherGrid): Uploaded metadata: https://partners.ciphergrid/staging/saml-meta.xml (48h). SCIM supports delta sync via /Users?filter=... and returns X-RateLimit headers. KMS staging latency: p50=4ms, p95=16ms, p99=60ms. Attestation bundle coming.

noor (Security): Requirements: IP allowlist template, mutual-TLS option for SCIM webhooks, HSM attestation bundle (cert chain + firmware hash), key policy for BYO-KMS, and SLA numbers. We also need a short threat model doc for the integration.

pat (SolutionsEng): Connector smoke steps (staging): create user via SCIM, delta-sync to pick up changes, create secret in CipherGrid, rotate key via KMS wrap/unwrap, fetch secret via Redwood runtime. I'll template a runbook and include backoff for rate limits.

viv (Eng): Run snippet (staging):
```
# create user
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.ciphergrid/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM>' -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng@redwood.com"}]}'
# trigger delta sync
curl -X GET 'https://scim.staging.ciphergrid/v2/Users?filter=meta.lastModified>2026-01-01' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM>'
# create secret
curl -X POST https://staging.ciphergrid/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API>' -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'
# fetch secret via Redwood
REDWOOD_SECRET=ciphergrid://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```

kevin (PM): Tentative timeline: internal dry-run Tue, partner validation Wed, marketplace canary Fri. Legal needs embargo window and MSA redline by Wed 10:00 PT.

legal-bot: Reminder: please upload the MSA draft to /collab/partners/CipherGrid and add a short approved co-brand phrase list before Wed 10:00 PT. Missing items may block the announcement.

samir (CipherGrid): We'll push the attestation bundle, delta sync docs, and MSA redline by EOD tomorrow. Also can provision a VPN-backed single-tenant HSM endpoint for your test VPC if helpful.

noor (Security): Two immediate blockers: 1) SCIM bulk import semantics (atomic vs chunked) 2) KMS concurrency limits under burst load. Need concrete numbers to size connector queues and timeouts.

samir (CipherGrid): SCIM bulk: chunked uploads allowed (max 500/user chunk) with Retry-After when throttled; supports atomic batches if requested. KMS concurrency (staging): max concurrent ops 250, p99 spikes under load ~85ms; we'll provide load test report.

pat (SolutionsEng): We'll support Retry-After handling, jittered backoff, and a small FIFO queue for bursts. I'll add connector metrics to surface throttling.

viv (Eng): Ops ask: if CipherGrid can provide the HSM cert thumbprint and a VPN contact, we can automate attestation checks and spin up the test harness.

samir (CipherGrid): Attestation thumbprint will be included. Infra contact: infra@ciphergrid.com. VPN setup ok with provided IP ranges and client certs.

dara (Partnerships): Action items captured:
- Samir: upload SAML metadata, attestation bundle, delta-sync docs, MSA redline, load test telemetry (by EOD tomorrow)
- Viv/Pat: finalize runbook + implement throttling/backoff handling (by Tue morning)
- Noor: draft security checklist, IP allowlist template, and threat model stub (today)
- Kevin: draft embargo window & announcement outline (by Tue)

dara (Partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min smoke-run call Wed 09:00 PT to walk the runbook and sign off the security checklist. I'll attach the runbook to the invite.

kevin (PM): I'll send the invite and include legal + infra owners.

viv (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness ready.

samir (CipherGrid): We'll join with infra lead and provide VPN details.

noor (Security): I'll sign off on the checklist during the call.

pat (SolutionsEng): I'll attach connector test scripts to the calendar invite.

dara (Partnerships): Note: marketplace tile copy stays internal until legal approves co-brand copy and BYO-KMS attestation is validated. No external PR until both sides sign. :lock:

samir (CipherGrid): Understood. Thanks all.
